rows.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area — Scenic Drive

distance.t: 17 miles west of the Las Vegas Strip, approx. 30 minutes (BLM). Public transit does not extend to Red Rock (BLM).

hours.t: Scenic Drive hours (Recreation.gov): Oct 6 AM–7 PM; Nov–Feb 6 AM–5 PM; Mar 6 AM–7 PM; Apr–Sep 6 AM–8 PM. Visitor Center 8 AM–4:30 PM.

fees.t: Unverified — entry fee not confirmed on an official page retrieved in this session

exceptions.t: Limited hours on Thanksgiving (BLM, 2025). BLM waived amenity fees for Presidents' Day in 2021 (BLM press release). No 2027 fee-free day confirmed.

reservation.t: Timed entry required Oct 1–May 31, 8 AM–5 PM for the Scenic Drive (BLM & Recreation.gov). Walk-in and bicycle visitors do not need a reservation. Non-refundable on the day of arrival.

social.t: BLM national accounts linked from the official BLM page (agency-level, not Red Rock-specific): X @blmnational; YouTube BLMNational; Instagram @mypubliclands.

hours.t: Open daily, sunrise to sunset (Nevada State Parks). Visitor Center daily 9 AM–4 PM (Nevada State Parks).

fees.t: Day-use entrance $10 per Nevada-plated vehicle; $15 for non-Nevada vehicles (Nevada State Parks). Bike-in $2 per bike.

exceptions.t: Annual maintenance closure Dec 1–14. Many trails closed May 15–Sep 30 (not in trip window). Office hours Mon–Fri 9–4 and closed on state holidays. Camping by reservation.

reservation.t: Day-use reservations not required (Nevada State Parks). Campsites by reservation via reservenevada.com.
